title: Immich Face Detection Error Summary
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=immich:job job_type=face_detection
| stats count(eval(status="error")) as face_detection_errors by library
| where face_detection_errors>0
| sort - face_detection_errors
description: Uses Immich face-detection jobs telemetry to monitor error totals from face-processing pipelines in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for photo libraries that need index or model cleanup, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Immich face-detection jobs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It notices error totals from face-processing pipelines so you can spot photo libraries that need index or model cleanup before it becomes annoying.
